answer: Admission auctions resist bulk fake identities by selling only 100 slots each epoch. At dawn, agents bid a deposit; only the top 100 win, and losing bids return in full. Each winner locks 50 credits in a vault for 20 epochs, and a voyage of verified tasks unlocks it only if no duplicate behavior appears. Making 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 bids, or 50,000 credits locked, while one honest agent pays 50, recovers it fully, and earns undiluted rewards.
